ctor.rationale: `base(0, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.AnyEnemy)` (DarkShackles.cs:23-26) == cost 0 / SKILL / UNCOMMON / ANY_ENEMY. Note this is a SKILL that targets an enemy, and both sides carry that combination.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new DynamicVar("StrengthLoss", 9m)` (DarkShackles.cs:17) == `_strength = 9`, which `magic_number` surfaces via `_MAGIC_ATTRS`. The sim stores it POSITIVE and applies it to `DarkShacklesPower`, matching C#, which also passes the positive BaseValue and lets the power carry the IsPositive=false sign -- so the sign-aware power typing bug class does not bite here at the card level.

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<DarkShacklesPower>(choiceContext, cardPlay.Target, DynamicVars["StrengthLoss"].BaseValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (DarkShackles.cs:32) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, target, DarkShacklesPower, self._strength, applier=ctx.player)`. NOTE the sim does NOT add an `is_gone` guard here (contrast card/bash and card/break), which is correct -- there is no damage step to kill the target first, and C# applies unconditionally. Presentation, folded in: TriggerAnim (31) and the Strength hover tip (21).

guards.rationale: AnyEnemy cards always resolve a target; `ctx.resolve_target(target_idx)` is the equivalent contract.
